Set Up Project Folder Structure

Source: R/setup_project_folders.R
setup_project_folders.Rd

Creates the standard folder structure used by the data cleaning pipeline. Safe to run on an existing project — folders that already exist are skipped with an informational message rather than overwritten or errored.

Usage

setup_project_folders(base_path = ".", extra_folders = NULL, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

base_path

Root directory of the project. Default "." (current working directory). Use here::here() for reproducible paths inside an R project.

extra_folders

Optional character vector of additional folder paths to create relative to base_path (e.g. c("output/archive", "output/checking")). Default NULL.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE (the default), a message is printed for each folder showing whether it was created or already existed.

Value

Invisibly returns a named logical vector: TRUE for each folder that was newly created, FALSE for folders that already existed.

Details

The following folders are created (relative to base_path):

data/

Raw data exports from ONA or other XLSForm platforms.

resources/

Supporting files: XLSForm tool, kobo/ONA choices, label files, logical check lists, etc.

output/

All outputs generated by the pipeline.

output/other_responses/

Filled other-responses review files matching the pattern _other_responses_edited.xlsx.

output/follow_ups/

Filled cleaning log review files matching the pattern _follow-ups_edited.xlsx.

output/final/

Final output workbooks produced by export_final_output().
